output_path_capability.question: Can the pinned upstream assembler write to a ContentOps-owned path outside <easel>/outputs?
evidence: upstream auto-short-video/scripts/assemble.py:361 does `out = Path(args.output); out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)` with no directory validation
the argparse help at line 627 describes outputs/<topic>/ as a convention, not an enforced check
scripts/assemble_easel.py now passes -o <project>/work/<tmp>/upstream.mp4 and sets TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR to <project>/work
output_path_capability.conclusion: Adapter-only change is sufficient; no upstream runtime write is required and .runtime/easel stays untouched.

proof_result.frame_contents: target terminal only; 'CONTENTOPS CAPTURE PROOF / read-only capability test / revision 8ce5e19'; no desktop content

constraints: capture is a desktop rectangle, not an occluded-window compositor; the window must stay topmost and unmoved
the recorder must re-read GetWindowRect after stopping and fail the capture if the rectangle changed
elevated terminal titles carry an '管理员: ' prefix; matching must use a suffix, not equality
audio must be disabled explicitly (gdigrab captures video only, but the driver must not add dshow audio)

probe_result.frame_inspection: only the target terminal is visible; no desktop or neighbouring-window content

defects_found_and_fixed_by_the_probe: recording.time_range was emitted with equal start and end; now relative to the recording's own zero
the sanitized PATH omitted git, so the probe returned cmd 9009; the declared executable's resolved directory is now added, without inheriting the parent PATH
GetWindowRect includes the invisible Windows resize border and filmed slivers of the window behind it; capture now uses DwmGetWindowAttribute(DWMWA_EXTENDED_FRAME_BOUNDS)
notes: the probe ran in an elevated console, which the plan's environment description records
capability probe receipts stay in the agent temp root and are never used as claim evidence
